posts.title: AI as Tutor: The Other Half of the AI Revolution
posts.description: The AI industry pours nearly all its effort into getting tasks done, but rarely asks how AI could help people grow. This piece argues AI as Tutor must become an equal, first-class goal alongside AI as Agent.

posts.title: How Should We Use AI in Education?
posts.description: Should AI just do a student's homework? This essay separates AI as Agent, which finishes tasks, from AI as Tutor, which builds ability, for education.

posts.title: I Built an Extension That Connects Claude.ai Web Chat to Local Folders: claudeFS
posts.description: claudeFS is a free, open-source Chrome/Edge extension letting Claude.ai web chat read, search, and edit local files directly — no Claude Code or API key needed.
